body:
Iterating on ECOWAR mechanics after Phase 2's in-match input path shipped: added a real shared cooldown (ECOWAR_CARD_COOLDOWN_MS=4000ms across all 16 cards, not a per-card table/mana economy -- that's real deck-building territory the founder hasn't scoped yet) gating arena_ecowar_play_card the same way every Q/W/R already gates itself; decremented in tick_hero_kit (same shared-tick placement as Duck's Smoke Bomb, avoiding the S202-23 bug class). 6 new tests. Then added a real HUD tile (networked ecowar_card_cooldown_ms, same blink_cooldown_ms wire pattern) showing the currently-armed card's name and real cooldown countdown -- the card system now has the same real affordances (cooldown gating + visual feedback) every other ability in this engine already has, not just a bare, silent trigger. 15 total card tests, gcc+bazel build/test both clean, real live matchmaker+bot verification re-run with the updated wire protocol. ECOWAR commits d470555/e044f80.

⚓ ☃
title: Card cooldown + HUD tile: real, complete v0 card mechanic (cont. Phase 2)
